FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
No Left Turn bans both left turns and U-turns, while No U-Turn bans only the U-turn [A01].
Why it matters: group sign-meaning; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F08, sec03-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Do Not Enter and Wrong Way order an immediate slowdown and turnaround, while One Way only reports the legal flow direction [A01].
Why it matters: group sign-meaning; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F06, sec03-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
No Turn on Red holds you until the green signal, while Left Turn Yield on Green lets you turn after stopping and yielding to oncoming traffic [A01].
Why it matters: group sign-meaning; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F09, sec03-F11 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
Vertical rectangles state instructions or law, while horizontal rectangles give directions or information [A01].
Why it matters: group sign-meaning; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
Fixed posted limits hold in good weather, while electronic limits on some roads change with weather or traffic [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A01
Lane Use Control arrows command the lane's turn, while a Keep Right arrow steers you past an island, median, or barrier [A01].
Why it matters: group lane-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F13, sec03-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
An advisory speed recommends the safe exit speed, while a Reduced Speed Limit Ahead sign announces a coming legal limit change [A02].
Why it matters: group speed-signs; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A02
At a merge both lanes share the blending duty, while at a lane reduction the ending right lane must merge and the left lane must admit [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F20, sec03-F21 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A02
Divided Highway Begins splits travel into two one-way roadways, while Divided Highway Ends returns both directions to one road [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F22 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: FXsec03R10
Pedestrian crossings call for slowing and readiness to stop; bicycle crossings call for careful driving. At school zones or crossings, watch for children, be ready to slow or stop, and follow the speed restriction and crossing guards [FXsec03R10].
Why it matters: group crossing-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F27, sec03-F28 [FXsec03R10].
Source: [FXsec03R10 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A02
Near horse-drawn buggies you must slow, skip the horn, and keep three feet of clearance, while near farm equipment you slow or stop and pass only when clear [A02].
Why it matters: group crossing-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F26 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
